title: Back-to-School Season with Noodles & Company
body_markdown:
# Back-to-School Season with Noodles & Company


Back to school season has started and with it comes busy schedules. We all know how cram-packed the days get and how hard it is to find time to make quick and healthy meals.[Noodles & Company](https://www.noodles.com/) is here to help by providing convenient, delicious, and balanced options at the best value for your wallet. Whether you are a busy mom on the go or a college student just starting out, we are here for your needs. To further support, we are providing special Rewards and offers throughout the back-to-school season! Here are all the fun opportunities coming up for each one of our guests, including[Noodles Rewards](https://www.noodles.com/rewards) members, College Students and pasta lovers alike.


### Special Noodles Rewards for College Students


Going to college for the first time and moving into the dorms is one of the most exciting and nerve-wracking experiences. Being in a new environment and surrounded by new people is daunting, but we’re here to provide those familiar flavors and comfort dishes that can help make you a little less homesick. Plus, now that you’re on your own, there’s no one to tell you that you can’t order[Buttered Parmesan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/buttery-parmesan-noodles) for a fourth time that week. :)


To make those first days less stressful, 50 Noodles & Company locations near select universities will be offering students a buy- one-get-one free deal during their campus’ Welcome Week.


### Checklist to Qualify for This Weeklong Offer:


☐ Join Noodles Rewards
☐ Select one of the participating locations as your Favorite Location (all locations are listed below.)
☐ Opt-in to receive Noodles email communications The reward will show up on your Rewards app. Please allow some time if it does not appear right away. You can mix and match to your heart’s desire so that you can share with your new roommate or keep them both for yourself. It’s meal prepping, right? This offer is available throughout the month of August matching up with your local campus’ Welcome Week, so keep checking your Rewards app if you are a college student to see if you receive the reward! ### Meet Our Student Ambassadors for Noodles & Company


Noodles & Company is also launching its first-ever Back-to-School College Student Ambassador Program. Across six campuses nationwide, including the University of Colorado Boulder, the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, the University of Chicago, Indiania University Bloomington and Arizona State University—various student ambassadors will create social content, host campus activations, and help spread the word about their local Noodles restaurant.


As a brand, Noodles & Company loves nourishing students and providing a welcoming place that feels like home, where they can enjoy a comforting meal at a great value while navigating the busy school year. Keep an eye on social media for these fun activations! If you have an interest in being a student ambassador, please email[\[email protected\] .](https://www.noodles.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#41322e2228202d2c24252820012f2e2e252d24326f222e2c)


Image


### Noodles Catering Options for Back to School


Back-to-school season is busy enough on its own, and events like the first day of school or graduations can make schedules even more hectic. Noodles & Company makes feeding a large group easy and convenient with delicious catering options that you can customize to your heart’s content.


Guests can customize their spread to fit the occasion, with choices for younger eaters— like a[Mac Bar](https://www.noodles.com/catering/mac-bar) where they can mix and match toppings or skip them altogether—as well as bold, on-trend dishes like[Spicy Korean Steak Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/spicy-korean-steak-noodles) that appeal to older teens. There is something for everyone at Noodles & Company. Check out our Catering packages[here](https://www.noodles.com/catering) to view your options and place an order for your next event today.


### Back to School Meals Made Easy


A[recent study](https://investor.noodles.com/news-releases/news-release-details/noodles-company-welcomes-comfort-food-season-new-baked-cheese) we conducted showed that 40% of parents say they feel very or extremely overwhelmed by the number of family-related decisions they make during the back-to- school season, with almost two-thirds reporting that meal planning, grocery shopping and cooking are among the biggest contributors to their daily mental load.


And that’s why Noodles & Company is happy to offer a multitude of options for busy families, and we always want to provide the best value for your wallet. Quick, easy ideas for dinner are our specialty, and we’d love to take the “what to have for dinner” off your plate!


We recommend our[Delicious Duos](https://www.noodles.com/menu/delicious-duos) option as it is a great, affordable option for families who want the comfort of their favorite pasta bowl, paired with something a bit healthier like a salad or a side of[Lemon Parmesan Broccoli](https://www.noodles.com/menu/sides/lemon-parmesan-broccoli) . It all balances out! While it comes at a value-sized price, the portion remains the same as a small bowl, so you get the most for your money.


We also always have a Kid’s Menu available that features kid-friendly favorites such as[Buttery Parmesan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/kids-meals/buttery-parmesan-noodles) and the[Creamy Cheddar Mac and Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/kids-meals/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese) that conveniently come with a side, a beverage and a kid-sized crispy. This option truly takes the pressure off parents who need a break from planning dinner following a long day of after-school activities and a hectic schedule.


### Noodles & Company is Every Back-to-School Moment


Noodles & Company is here for every season of life, and we are proud to support students and families during this busy time of year. Whether you are:


• A high school student looking for fuel after soccer practice.
• A parent searching for a balanced, nutritious meal for your elementary student.
•Teachers balancing a busy Back to School PTA night.
•A college freshman’s go to comfort meal when settling into the dorms.
•Or anyone who needs a convenient, comforting option on a hectic day.
We are here whenever you need us. If you ever have questions or concerns, please reach out to us at contactnoodles.smg.com. We know noodles, and we will always do what we can to help.


### Frequently Asked Questions


**How can I find the closest Noodles & Company location to me?**
All Noodles & Company locations are conveniently listed by state on our website. Or if you select the ‘Order Now’ option, you can input your address and find the nearest Noodles in your area.


**How can I qualify for exclusive offers from Noodles & Company?**
Everyone who signs up for the Noodles Rewards Program is eligible to receive special rewards! Guests can sign up either on the app or on our[Rewards page](https://www.noodles.com/rewards) by inputting your information. Curious about how Noodles Rewards works? Check out our[Rewards Blog](https://www.noodles.com/blog/rewards) that breaks it all down for you.


**How do I know which Noodles Catering Package is right for me?**
We have a[variety of packages](https://catering.noodles.com/) for any sized gathering to suit your needs! We offer a Feed the Few package that serves up to 10 guests as well as a Feed the Many package that can accommodate up to 20. Both options include your choice of noodles and salad, along with dessert and beverages. If you prefer to customize your catering order, simply select however many pans of noodles you think you will need for your event! Please note that each pan serves up to 8 guests.


**Where can I find nutritional information for the Noodles & Company menu?**
Nutritional information for our menu can be found by visiting our[Nutritional Calculator](https://noodles.mymenuhd.com/MyMenu/Restaurant?sView=default) . This tool is customizable to fit your preferences by having a variety of options you can select and adjust. Whether you are gluten-free or want something a little lighter, the Nutritional Calculator will help you find the dish that fits your needs best.
